name: sigelo-sim
description: Seeded swarm simulation of sigelo agents, worlds and a keeper (see README.md)

scripts.build: cd ../ts && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npx tsc && cd ../spend && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npx tsc
scripts.sim: node swarm.mjs && node worlds.mjs && node keeper-swarm.mjs && node keeper-scenarios.mjs
scripts.plants: node worlds.mjs --plant bare-genesis --no-go && node keeper-scenarios.mjs --mutants && node keeper-swarm.mjs --selftest && node mutants.mjs
